method: Method B — launch story. PPC Guru launched the account ~Mar 2026. Genuine phone-call tracking began firing in May 2026. Primary comparison: first tracked month (May 2026) vs most recent complete month (Jul 2026). Q2 2026 quarterly total is also reported.
genuine_lead_definition: Genuine leads = PHONE_CALL_LEAD + SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM conversions. Excludes OUTBOUND_CLICK (WhatsApp button clicks) and all Google Business Profile local actions, which inflate raw metrics.conversions and all_conversions.

monthly_genuine_leads.note: April raw conversions (10) were all WhatsApp button clicks; genuine phone/form leads not yet tracked. Phone-call tracking live from May 2026.

quarterly_genuine_leads.note: Q2 includes April (genuine 0, pre-call-tracking) + May 6 + June 44.

changes_summary.cost_per_lead: $35 (May) to ~$18 (Jul) — roughly halved as volume scaled

presentation_note: Genuine phone/form leads only. April's raw 10 conversions (all WhatsApp clicks) and the heavy local-action inflation of all_conversions are excluded. The ramp 6 -> 44 -> 56 with a falling cost per lead is real and taken directly from category-segmented conversion data.
